sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Laboratory"."ID" AS e, AVG("Laboratory"."TAT2") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Laboratory"."IGA" - "Laboratory"."T-BIL") AS REAL) / "Laboratory"."T-BIL")) AS m2 FROM "Laboratory" GROUP BY "Laboratory"."ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3"
